name: Spec review → tickets
summary: Validate a plan or tech spec against the real code, then turn it into a ticket breakdown.
when: A ticket or spec landed and the work has to be understood, challenged and sliced before anyone builds it.
fanOutHint: One repo or area per line — each gets its own agent (e.g. "llp-renderer: how templates resolve").

stages.name: Read the ground truth
stages.instruction: Read the ticket, the linked spec, and the code paths it actually touches. Quote the code, not the spec's description of it. Note where the two disagree.

stages.name: Challenge it
stages.instruction: List what the spec gets wrong, what is ambiguous, and what it leaves out — each with the evidence from the code that shows it. Include the risks that would only surface at runtime. Do not soften the findings.

stages.name: Draft the breakdown
stages.instruction: Draft the ticket breakdown: phases, one ticket per shippable deliverable, dependencies stated as links, and what is explicitly out of scope. Show it to me before writing anything to Jira.

stages.name: Create in Jira
stages.instruction: Create the tickets and the issue links exactly as approved, then give me the ticket numbers and URLs.

stages.name: Log the work
stages.instruction: Log the time against the right ticket. Keep the description brief and coarse.
